heading.en: Plus and minus, held close together

hook.en: A water molecule is neutral, yet it turns to line up in an *electric* field. Its positive and negative charge centres are slightly apart: it is a dipole. Microwave ovens heat food by twisting these dipoles back and forth.
hook.kn: ನೀರಿನ ಅಣು ತಟಸ್ಥವಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ಸಾಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣ ಆವೇಶ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ: ಅದು ಒಂದು ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ.

say.en: A water molecule is neutral, yet it turns to line up in an electric field. Its positive and negative charge centres are slightly apart: it is a dipole. Microwave ovens heat food by twisting these dipoles back and forth. In this lesson: Define dipole moment and find the field on the axis and the equatorial line.
Find the torque on a dipole in a uniform field.

title.en: Dipole moment and the dipole field

body.en: An electric dipole is a pair of equal and opposite charges ±q separated by a distance 2a. Its *dipole moment* $\vec p$ has magnitude $q\times2a$ and points from −q to +q (unit C m). Far from the dipole (r ≫ a) the field on the axis is $2kp/r^3$ along $\vec p$, and on the equatorial line it is $kp/r^3$ opposite to $\vec p$. A dipole's field falls as 1/r³, faster than a point charge's 1/r².
body.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಎಂದರೆ 2a ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ +q ಮತ್ತು −q. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಭ್ರಾಮಕ p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³, ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³.

points.en: Equatorial: E = kp/r³ opposite to p

narration.en: A dipole is plus q and minus q separated by 2a. Its moment p equals q times 2a and points from the negative to the positive charge. Far away, the axial field is 2kp by r cubed and the equatorial field is kp by r cubed.
narration.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಎಂದರೆ 2a ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ +q ಮತ್ತು −q. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಭ್ರಾಮಕ p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³, ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³.

say.en: A dipole is plus q and minus q separated by 2a. Its moment p equals q times 2a and points from the negative to the positive charge. Far away, the axial field is 2kp by r cubed and the equatorial field is kp by r cubed. p equals q times 2a, from -q to plus q.
say.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಎಂದರೆ 2a ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ plus q ಮತ್ತು -q. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಭ್ರಾಮಕ p equals q times 2a, -q ಇಂದ plus q ಕಡೆಗೆ. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r cubed, ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp over r cubed.

say.en: Axial: E equals 2kp/r cubed along p.
Equatorial: E equals kp over r cubed opposite to p.

title.en: On the board: the electric dipole

narration.en: A dipole is −q and +q a small distance 2a apart; its moment p = q × 2a points from − to +. On the axis the field is 2kp/r³ along p; on the equatorial line it is kp/r³, opposite to p. In a uniform field the forces qE and −qE cancel, but they form a couple that turns the dipole. The torque is largest when p is at right angles to E and zero when p lies along E. Its potential energy is −pE cos θ, lowest when p points along E: that is the stable position.

say.en: A dipole is −q and +q a small distance 2a apart; its moment p = q × 2a points from − to +.
On the axis the field is 2kp/r³ along p; on the equatorial line it is kp/r³, opposite to p.
In a uniform field the forces qE and −qE cancel, but they form a couple that turns the dipole.
The torque is largest when p is at right angles to E and zero when p lies along E.
Its potential energy is −pE cos θ, lowest when p points along E: that is the stable position.

A dipole is -q and plus q a small distance 2a apart; its moment p equals q times 2a points from - to plus. On the axis the field is 2kp/r cubed along p; on the equatorial line it is kp over r cubed, opposite to p. In a uniform field the forces qE and -qE cancel, but they form a couple that turns the dipole. The torque is largest when p is at right angles to E and zero when p lies along E. Its potential energy is -pE cos theta, lowest when p points along E: that is the stable position.

title.en: An electric dipole in a uniform field

narration.en: The forces +qE and −qE are equal and opposite, so the net force is zero, but they form a couple. The torque τ = pE sin θ turns the dipole towards the field. With damping it settles at θ = 0, the position of least energy U = −pE cos θ. The turning speed is not to scale.
narration.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ. ಸ್ಲೈಡರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ, ಓದುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

caption.en: The forces +qE and −qE are equal and opposite, so the net force is zero, but they form a couple. The torque τ = pE sin θ turns the dipole towards the field. With damping it settles at θ = 0, the position of least energy U = −pE cos θ. The turning speed is not to scale.
caption.kn: +qE ಮತ್ತು −qE ಬಲಗಳು ಸಮ ಮತ್ತು ವಿರುದ್ಧ, ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರೆ ಯುಗ್ಮ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = pE sin θ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವವನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದತ್ತ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವಮಂದನದೊಂದಿಗೆ θ = 0 ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = −pE cos θ.

say.en: The forces plus qE and -qE are equal and opposite, so the net force is zero, but they form a couple. The torque tau equals pE sin theta turns the dipole towards the field. With damping it settles at theta equals 0, the position of least energy U equals -pE cos theta. The turning speed is not to scale.

title.en: Dipole in a uniform external field

body.en: In a *uniform* field the forces +qE and −qE are equal and opposite, so the net force is zero. But they act at different points and form a couple of torque $\tau = pE\sin\theta$, which turns $\vec p$ towards $\vec E$. θ = 0° is stable equilibrium and θ = 180° is unstable. In a non-uniform field there is also a net force.
body.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = pE sinθ ಅದನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: τ = pE sin θ, maximum at 90°

narration.en: In a uniform field a dipole feels no net force, but it feels a torque p E sin theta that turns it to line up with the field. Aligned is stable; opposite is unstable.
narration.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = pE sinθ ಅದನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

theta equals 0 degrees stable, theta equals 180 degrees unstable.

caption.en: Torque τ = pE sin θ and potential energy U = −pE cos θ of a dipole in a uniform field. p is in 10⁻⁹ C m and E in 10⁴ N/C, so τ and U come out in 10⁻⁵ units.

tryThis.en: Move θ to 90°: the torque is greatest and U is zero.
Move θ to 180°: no torque, but U is highest. Is that a stable position?
Double E: both curves stretch to double their height.

problem.en: A dipole has charges ±2 nC separated by 4 mm. Find its dipole moment and the torque on it in a uniform field of 5 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ at 30° to the field.

answer.en: p = 8 × 10⁻¹² C m; τ = 2 × 10⁻⁷ N m

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A dipole has charges ±2 nC separated by 4 mm. Find its dipole moment and the torque on it in a uniform field of 5 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ at 30° to the field.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A dipole has charges plus or minus 2 nC separated by 4 millimetres. Find its dipole moment and the torque on it in a uniform field of 5 times 10 to the power 4 newtons C to the power minus 1 at 30 degrees to the field.
p equals q times 2a equals 2 times 10 to the power minus 9 times 4 times 10 to the power minus 3 equals 8 times 10 to the power minus 12 C m.
tau equals pE sin theta equals 8 times 10 to the power minus 12 times 5 times 10 to the power 4 times sin 30 degrees.
tau equals 4 times 10 to the power minus 7 times 0.5 equals 2 times 10 to the power minus 7 newtons m.
So the answer is p equals 8 times 10 to the power minus 12 C m; tau equals 2 times 10 to the power minus 7 newtons m.

problem.en: A short dipole has p = 4 × 10⁻⁹ C m. Find the field 10 cm away on its axis and on its equatorial line.

= 72 divided by 10 to the power minus 3 equals 7.2 times 10 to the power 4 newtons C to the power minus 1.

narration.kn: ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ಈ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಮಾದರಿಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ.

say.en: Pause and solve this exam pattern question. The electric field at a point on the axis of a short dipole, at distance r from its centre, is E. The field at a point on its equatorial line at distance 2r is.
E equals 2kp/r cubed on the axis.
On the equator at 2r, E' = kp over 2r cubed equals kp over 8r cubed equals E over 16.

narration.en: Competitive exam practice: JEE, KCET, COMEDK and NEET pattern questions. Some have more than one correct option, and some need a number as the answer.

points.en: p = q × 2a, from −q to +q; unit C m.
points.kn: p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ; ಏಕಮಾನ C m.

points.en: In a uniform field: zero net force, torque pE sin θ.
points.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಟಾರ್ಕ್ pE sinθ.

homework.en: Find the torque on a dipole of moment 5 × 10⁻⁹ C m at 60° to a field of 2 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹.

narration.en: Recap. p = q × 2a, from −q to +q; unit C m. Axial field 2kp/r³; equatorial field kp/r³. In a uniform field: zero net force, torque pE sin θ.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ; ಏಕಮಾನ C m. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³; ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³. ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಟಾರ್ಕ್ pE sinθ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. p equals q times 2a, from -q to plus q; unit C m.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. p equals q times 2a, -q ಇಂದ plus q ಕಡೆಗೆ; ಏಕಮಾನ C m.

say.en: Axial field 2kp/r cubed; equatorial field kp over r cubed.
say.kn: ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r cubed; ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp over r cubed.

say.en: In a uniform field: zero net force, torque pE sin theta.
say.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಟಾರ್ಕ್ pE sin theta.
